title: Settle writer state for proven id-less Codex refusals
outcome: A proven completion for a command without a usable native item ID does not leave its uniquely owned current writer or shell move open.
acceptance: A real router test exercises a refused id-less command without an item ID and verifies its own writer and pending shell state are settled when ownership is unique.
The refused observation remains unchanged, with no artifact or credit, and ambiguity never retires another execution.
